# hippo_test

Dev-only Flutter feature harness and inspectable local test reports.

- Public Flutter API: lib/hippo_test.dart
- Plain Dart report generation: lib/report.dart
- CLI: bin/hippo_test.dart (dart run hippo_test)
- Consumer setup, boundaries, and commands: README.md
- Meaningful negative-path verification: tool/verify_runner.dart

Keep domain fixtures and user actions in the consuming product. Do not label a
feature host or a mocked backend as end-to-end coverage. Preserve Flutter's final
runner outcome, including compilation and teardown errors. Never auto-accept
goldens during verification. Every run gets an isolated artifact directory.
